name: Wu Ji Zhi Tan
source:
Streamer Jia Xu (“Eggy”) uses a cheat to beat a mysterious player called “I Am God” on stream—and gets hit with an eerie “payback.” That night he dreams a twin-tail girl blasts him… in the groin. Worse, he wakes up and realizes he’s actually turned into a girl.

Now Eggy has to survive in a men’s dorm with:

his inseparable best friend Monkey,

Monkey’s girlfriend Qin Lian,

the campus queen Wu Yangyang (same curse, frosty looks + tough-guy attitude), and

Pangpang, a chaotic travel companion who used to be a sweet girl and is now a chubby boy.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3516580/Ballshit/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主播贾旭（“蛋蛋”）在直播中使用作弊击败了一位名叫“我是神”的神秘玩家，并遭到了令人毛骨悚然的“报复”。那天晚上，他梦见一个双马尾女孩射中了他……腹股沟。更糟糕的是，他醒来后发现自己实际上变成了一个女孩。

现在Eggy必须在男生宿舍里生存：

他形影不离的好朋友猴子，

猴子的女朋友秦莲，

校园女王吴阳阳（同样的诅咒，冷酷的外表+硬汉态度），以及

胖胖，一个乱七八糟的旅伴，曾经是一个甜美的女孩，现在是一个胖乎乎的男孩。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3516580/Ballshit/]Steam[/url]]
